headline: Violent Island Incursions Persist Amid Escalating Heavy Mainland Attrition
war_summary: Maritime and island skirmishes have intensified over the past three hours, led by rapid base turnovers on Fishermans Row where contested positions including Fort Ember, Arcadia, and Peripti Landing continue swinging between opposing forces. In Lykos Isle, relentless clashes around Mārudia and Fort Guile have left positions heavily contested and reduced one strategic post to ruins. Across the mainland, the sharp Colonial advance previously observed in Weathered Expanse has settled into a grinding attritional battle, logging over four thousand combined casualties in two hours as fighting centers around Spirit Watch. Dead Lands endures similarly intense bloodshed, with Warden captures consolidating ground near The Salt March and Callahan's Boot amid nearly six thousand fresh casualties. Along the eastern sector, Stlican Shelf sustains severe pressure near Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn, while high casualty rates across Farranac Coast, Linn of Mercy, and Kings Cage reflect heavy contact along entrenched perimeters without immediate shifts in base ownership.
